channel.description: Recent content in Azure on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Governance policy guidance in Foundry Canvas and VS Code
item.description:
Governance policy guidance is now generally available in Foundry Canvas and the Foundry Toolkit for Visual Studio Code. As agents are built, both surfaces show relevant policies for agent types, models, toolboxes, and guardrails, including warnings.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Microsoft Copilot harness support in Foundry Toolkit for VS Code
item.description:
Agent Builder in Microsoft Foundry Toolkit for VS Code now supports prompt agents using the Microsoft Copilot harness in public preview. Developers can configure tools and skills, edit local YAML definitions, deploy changes to Foundry, and run the agents.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: Support for Azure Functions OpenAI Extension ends on April 20, 2027
item.description:
Support for the Azure Functions OpenAI extension ends on April 20, 2027. Users should migrate to the appropriate direct SDKs before that date, including OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry, or Azure AI Search SDKs depending on the scenario.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Programmed Training in Microsoft Foundry
item.description:
Programmed Training is now in public preview in Microsoft Foundry. It provides an API for building custom post-training loops over open-weight models, with access available by request through a preview sign-up form.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Multi-turn evaluation in Microsoft Foundry
item.description:
Microsoft Foundry now offers multi-turn evaluation in public preview. It lets you assess full agent conversations against quality standards instead of evaluating only individual responses.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Firewall for Containers
item.description:
Azure Firewall for Containers is in public preview. It extends Azure Firewall protections to containerized workloads so network traffic for container environments can be secured and managed centrally.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: Multiparty private offers in Microsoft Marketplace expands to Malaysia and Saudi Arabia
item.description:
Multiparty private offers in Microsoft Marketplace now support Malaysia and Saudi Arabia. This lets partners procure third-party cloud and AI solutions for customers in those markets through Marketplace.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Soft delete in Azure Compute Gallery
item.description:
Soft delete for Azure Compute Gallery is now generally available. Deleted image versions can be recovered within a configurable retention period of 7 to 365 days, and deployments can still use soft-deleted images during that period.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: PostgreSQL 19 on Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server now supports PostgreSQL 19 in public preview in the East Asia region. You can provision new PostgreSQL 19 servers via the Azure portal and Azure CLI.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Zone resilience for Azure VMs
item.description:
Zone resilience for Azure VMs is in public preview. It allows an eligible zonal VM to be recovered in another availability zone within the same region while keeping the existing VM resource and configuration, with ZRS managed disks used for synchronous cross-zone replication.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Database Agent for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Public preview of Database Agent for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. The feature monitors database health proactively and helps detect, understand, and respond to performance and health issues faster.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: AI bot ruleset for Azure Front Door Premium WAF
item.description:
Azure Front Door Premium WAF now has a public preview AI bot ruleset. It lets you control access for AI crawlers and agents, complementing robots.txt for finer-grained traffic handling.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: The new Azure Databricks on Azure Government is now in Beta
item.description:
Azure Databricks is now available in Beta on Microsoft Azure Government. It provides the Databricks data and AI platform for U.S. public sector agencies and partners as a first-party Azure service.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Cross-subscription backup for Azure Virtual Machines in Azure Backup
item.description:
Azure Backup now supports cross-subscription backup for Azure Virtual Machines. You can protect VMs with a Recovery Services vault in a different Azure subscription, as long as it is in the same tenant.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: AI-powered application and database modernization with Modernize CLI
item.description:
Modernize CLI is in public preview for AI-assisted application and database modernization. It assesses application architecture, dependencies, cloud readiness, and the databases an application uses to guide modernization as a connected workflow.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Immutable snapshots for Azure Disk Storage
item.description:
Immutable snapshots for Azure Disk Storage are now in public preview. They complement Azure Backup immutable vaults by providing a short-term backup option with faster recovery characteristics.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Announcing: Azure Boost observability for NVMe disks
item.description:
Azure Boost observability for NVMe disks is an open-source CLI tool for compatible Azure VMs. It reports remote disk I/O and latency metrics and maps each in-VM disk to the corresponding disk.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Generally Available: Cobalt 200 Arm-based Dplsv7, Dpsv7, Epsv7, Mpsv4, and Lpsv5-series Virtual Machines
item.description:
Azure has made Cobalt 200 Arm-based VM series generally available across several SKUs, including Dpsv7/Dplsv7, Epsv7, Mpsv4, and Lpsv5. The update says these VMs improve on the previous Cobalt 100 generation.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Intel and AMD v6 with temp disk for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server is now generally available on Intel and AMD v6 compute tiers with local temporary disk. The new generation adds higher performance and larger scale options to the Flexible Server portfolio.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Intel and AMD v5 diskless tier for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server now generally available on Intel and AMD v5 diskless compute. The new General Purpose and Memory Optimized SKUs do not include local temporary storage.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Cobalt 200 compute for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server now generally available on Cobalt 200, a Microsoft-designed ARM64 compute option. It expands the Flexible Server compute portfolio with an additional architecture choice.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Geo-redundant backup and restore for Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Geo-redundant backup and restore is now generally available for Azure HorizonDB. It lets you store backups in a geo-redundant way and restore a HorizonDB deployment in another Azure region when needed.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Generally Available: Customize backup retention from 1 to 35 days in Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB backup retention can now be configured from 1 to 35 days. This lets deployments match retention settings to application and data protection requirements.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Throughput buckets in Azure Cosmos DB
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB throughput buckets are now generally available. They let you cap the maximum throughput a workload can consume within the same container, helping manage resource usage across multiple workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Limited Preview: AI model management in Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now offers limited preview support for AI model management, letting users provision fully managed models directly in the database. The preview covers embeddings, semantic ranking, and generation.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Semantic Reranker in Azure Cosmos DB
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB now generally available supports a Semantic Reranker for search, which reorders candidate results using an AI model that considers the meaning of the query and surrounding context. The feature is intended to improve relevance by promoting better-matching documents.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Pod Sandboxing kata-vm-isolation-v2 runtime class
item.description:
Azure announced a public preview of the kata-vm-isolation-v2 runtime class for pod sandboxing. It is intended to improve isolated pod startup performance and reduce memory overhead compared with classic sandboxed pod flows that boot a new Kata VM per pod.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Pulic Preview: Azure Elastic SAN Next Generation
item.description:
Azure Elastic SAN Next Generation is now in public preview. It retains the existing Elastic SAN model, including a single SAN resource hierarchy for consolidating block storage workloads and dynamically sharing performance.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Limited Preview: Azure Workload Center for SAP and Azure Copilot Run SAP Agent
item.description:
Azure Workload Center for SAP is now available in limited preview, paired with Azure Copilot Run SAP Agent. The feature provides a workload-aware experience for operating SAP on Azure, powered by Workload Virtual Instance (WVI).

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Limited Preview: Azure Workload Center for Oracle and Azure Copilot Run Oracle Agent
item.description:
Azure Workload Center for Oracle and the Azure Copilot Run Oracle Agent are in preview as a workload-aware experience for operating Oracle workloads on Azure. The feature is powered by Workload Virtual Instance (WVI).

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Database Agent for SQL with contextual Copilot
item.description:
Database Agent for SQL is now in public preview with contextual Copilot-generated recommendations for detected database issues. The recommendations are grounded in available issue evidence and explain why the issue matters, the likely cause, and the next step.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Database Hub real-time performance dashboards
item.description:
Microsoft Fabric Database Hub now provides built-in, real-time performance dashboards for Microsoft SQL, Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server, and Azure Cosmos DB. The dashboards are accessible from the Performance page and consolidate monitoring in one place.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In development] Private Preview: Azure DH/EHasv8 VMs based on 6th Gen AMD EPYC™ (“Venice”) processors
item.description:
Azure is previewing new DHasv8, DHalsv8, and EHasv8 virtual machine series powered by 6th Gen AMD EPYC (“Venice”) processors. The announcement says these VMs are aimed at next-generation cloud applications and provide expanded compute.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL DB Hyperscale Cross Database Querying
item.description:
Azure SQL Database Hyperscale now supports native cross-database querying in public preview. Applications can access and join data across databases in the same Hyperscale elastic pool on a logical server using three-part T-SQL names.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Near-instant provisioning for Azure DocumentDB clusters
item.description:
Azure DocumentDB now supports near-instant provisioning for M10 through M30 compute tiers. This extends the earlier instant-provisioning capability that was previously limited to the free tier.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Confidential VMs with OS Disk Encryption support on AKS
item.description:
Azure AKS confidential VM node pools now support OS disk encryption in public preview. This closes the at-rest gap for regulated customers by adding platform support for encrypting the OS disk on Ubuntu 26.04 confidential VM node pools.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Confidential VMs with Intel TDX support on AKS
item.description:
AKS Confidential VM node pools now support Intel TDX in generally available state. This addresses the previous limitation where CVM node images only supported AMD SEV-SNP, preventing Intel TDX workloads from running on AKS.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Generally Available: Private endpoint support for Azure HorizonDB clusters
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB clusters now support private connectivity through Azure Private Link with a private IP from your virtual network. Private DNS integration simplifies setup, and public access can be disabled for tighter network control.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Service tags for inbound rules in network security perimeter
item.description:
Azure announced public preview support for using service tags as inbound rules for third-party customers in network security perimeter. The feature is meant to simplify access management for network security perimeter-protected resources.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Perimeter link (cross perimeter) in network security perimeter
item.description:
Public preview adds perimeter links for secure cross-perimeter connectivity between resources protected by different network security perimeters, while preserving perimeter-based access controls.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Agent Grid helping secure AI agent communications
item.description:
Agent Grid is now in public preview for supported Azure environments. It adds identity-based Zero Trust network security so security teams can centrally govern communication between agents, models, tools, and external services.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Adaptive Virtual Patching
item.description:
Azure Adaptive Virtual Patching is in public preview. It uses an AI-orchestrated Adaptive Shield to reduce exposure to new, emerging, and newly disclosed zero-day vulnerabilities while customers test and deploy patches, starting with Linux workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: AI Security add-on for Azure Firewall Premium
item.description:
Azure Firewall Premium now has a public preview AI Security add-on. It adds five capabilities aimed at protecting AI applications, sensitive data, and malware/application defenses.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Bastion RDP and SSH vision
item.description:
Azure Bastion RDP and SSH vision is in public preview. It adds AI-assisted review for recorded privileged sessions, including session summaries and insights into noteworthy or risky activity.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Agent Sandbox cluster extension
item.description:
Azure is introducing a public preview of an Agent Sandbox cluster extension for Kubernetes. It provides isolated environments for AI agent sessions that run untrusted, model-generated code, reducing the need for teams to build their own sandbox lifecycle and related operational logic.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure API Management Application
item.description:
Azure API Management Applications is now in public preview for all customers, with no sign-up required. The feature helps organize APIs around consuming applications and manage application-level relationships.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Scale ExpressRoute Direct connectivity with link groups
item.description:
Azure ExpressRoute Direct now supports link groups in public preview. This lets high-throughput workloads scale connectivity by aggregating links, reducing the need to manage multiple independent ExpressRoute connections.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In development] Private Preview: Azure confidential VMs on 5th Gen AMD EPYC processors (DCasv7 and ECasv7 series)
item.description:
Azure has put its next-generation confidential VM series into private preview. The DCasv7, DCadsv7, DCalsv7, DCaldsv7, ECasv7, and ECadsv7 series run on 5th Gen AMD EPYC processors with AMD SEV-SNP to protect data in use.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In development] Private Preview: Project Nova
item.description:
Project Nova is a private preview for independent verification of specific claims without exposing underlying data. It is aimed at regulated industries that need to establish trust while keeping confidential information protected.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In development] Private Preview: Slack integration for Azure SRE Agent
item.description:
Azure SRE Agent will support Slack in private preview. Teams can mention the agent in Slack channels to start or continue incident investigations in the place where responders already coordinate.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Generally Available: Azure DDoS Protection custom policy
item.description:
Azure DDoS Protection custom policy is now generally available. It lets users override the default machine-learning auto-tuned detection thresholds for protected resources to better fit specific workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: AI-assisted data modeler and other updates in Azure Cosmos DB extension for VS Code
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB extension for VS Code now includes a public preview AI-assisted Data Modeler. It helps design data models earlier by analyzing document structure, query patterns, write distribution, expected scale, and data growth.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Advanced load balancing in Azure Application Gateway
item.description:
Advanced load balancing for Azure Application Gateway is now in public preview. It adds more control over traffic distribution across backends for different workload types, including AI applications and web traffic.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol support in Azure SRE Agent
item.description:
Azure SRE Agent adds public preview support for the open Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol. This lets SRE agents delegate tasks to other agents and receive tasks from them while preserving each team’s permissions.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: AI Assisted Oracle-to-PostgreSQL Application Code Migration
item.description:
A preview plugin adds AI-assisted conversion of application code from Oracle to PostgreSQL. It can be used through GitHub Copilot CLI or Visual Studio Code to help applications work with Azure Database for PostgreSQL.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure App Service Builder
item.description:
Azure App Service Builder is in public preview. It provides a source-connected platform intended to simplify turning application code into a running cloud app by reducing the need to set up build pipelines, deployment workflows, and hosting infrastructure manually.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Application Gateway advanced routing rules
item.description:
Azure Application Gateway advanced routing rules is in public preview. It adds condition-based routing using HTTP request attributes, extending routing beyond traditional path- and host-based rules.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Application Gateway confidential compute support
item.description:
Azure Application Gateway confidential compute is now in public preview. It runs the Application Gateway data plane in a confidential computing environment to help protect sensitive data while requests are being processed, including after decryption.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Artifact Validation for VM images
item.description:
Azure Artifact Validation is now in public preview. It lets VM image publishers and enterprise platform teams run Azure certification-grade quality and security checks on images within their own Azure subscriptions at any point in the build process.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Blob Storage turbo tier
item.description:
Azure Blob Storage turbo tier is in Public Preview, adding SSD-backed performance for eligible Blob Storage accounts. It is intended for performance-sensitive workloads such as AI training, inference, and analytics.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Compute Spot plus
item.description:
Azure Compute Spot plus is now in public preview as an enhanced Azure Spot Virtual Machines tier. It is intended for interruption-tolerant workloads and offers greater runtime consistency plus earlier eviction signals.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Database for MySQL on Premium SSD v2
item.description:
Azure Database for MySQL now supports Premium SSD v2 managed disks in public preview. The update adds higher performance and better price-performance, with the ability to scale storage capacity independently.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure DDoS Protection peacetime telemetry
item.description:
Azure DDoS Protection peacetime telemetry is now in public preview. It lets customers view traffic to protected public IP addresses during normal operation, not just during active DDoS mitigation.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure DDoS Protection support for NAT Gateway v2 IP
item.description:
Azure DDoS Protection now supports the public IPs used by Azure NAT Gateway StandardV2 in public preview. This extends network-layer DDoS protection to IPv4 and IPv6 addresses carrying outbound internet traffic.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Files NFS shares on HDD
item.description:
Azure Files now supports NFS shares on HDD in public preview. This adds a lower-cost, fully managed option alongside the existing SSD-based NFS offering for Linux workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Functions Network Troubleshooter v2
item.description:
Azure Functions Network Troubleshooter v2 is now in public preview. It provides a top-down view of Function App dependencies across Storage, Service Bus, and Azure Files, with inspection details for supported dependencies.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Functions support for Node.js 26
item.description:
Azure Functions now supports Node.js 26 in public preview. Developers can test JavaScript and TypeScript function apps on the new runtime while continuing to use the Azure Functions programming model on Linux in Flex Consumption and Elastic Premium plans.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Functions support for Python 3.15
item.description:
Azure Functions now has public preview support for Python 3.15. Developers can test Python apps, dependencies, native extensions, and deployment workflows with the existing v1 and v2 programming models.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Managed Redis agent kit
item.description:
Azure Managed Redis agent kit is now in public preview. It adds Redis-specific guidance for building and operating production-ready Redis applications directly into AI-assisted development workflows.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Monitor traces and Trace Analytics
item.description:
Azure Monitor traces is now in public preview, adding dedicated trace analysis in Application Insights. It lets you analyze and compare large volumes of traces and drill from trends to root cause using distributed tracing.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Network Watcher – AI summary of connection troubleshoot results
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher now has a public preview feature that uses AI to summarize connection troubleshoot results. It is intended to make the output of the four diagnostic connectivity tests easier and faster to understand.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Network Watcher – Auto-create connection monitor
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher adds a public preview of auto-create connection monitor, which speeds up network monitoring setup across an Azure subscription. It replaces per-connection test creation with a subscription-wide creation flow.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Network Watcher – Connection analyzer
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher’s Connection analyzer for ExpressRoute Circuit is in public preview. It helps pinpoint where packet loss occurs between Azure and on-premises by providing faster, evidence-based troubleshooting.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Network Watcher – Packet capture insights
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher packet capture insights is in public preview. It uses AI-assisted analysis to surface findings from packet captures and can ingest structured protocol logs into Log Analytics for deeper investigation.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Network Watcher – Resource health and topology in connection monitor tests
item.description:
Azure Network Watcher connection monitor tests now include resource health metrics and key performance metrics in the test topology, powered by Network Watcher topology. This extends the topology view beyond just the path between source and destination.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL Database container provisioning in SQL Server Management Studio
item.description:
Azure SQL Database container provisioning is now in public preview in SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS). You can create a development environment in seconds without needing an Azure subscription, credit card, or existing database.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for mid-November 2026
item.description:
Azure SQL preview updates in mid-November 2026 add new SSMS Create and Apply wizards for working with .dacpac and .bacpac files. These wizards consolidate and replace the older workflow for creating and applying these package files.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Bring-your-own image and Cosmos DB MCP server in Azure Connector Namespace hosted MCP​
item.description:
Azure Connector Namespace now offers a public preview of hosted MCP server capability, letting AI agents use tools without developers managing a separate hosting stack. The preview also adds support for bring-your-own image and a Cosmos DB MCP server.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Build Knowledge Graphs with AI pipeline in Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now offers a public preview of an AI pipeline that builds knowledge graphs from PostgreSQL data. The feature uses AI to extract entities, relationships, and properties from source data and construct a queryable graph.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Build with Azure SQL Database container locally without an Azure subscription or credit card
item.description:
Azure SQL Database container is now in public preview for local development and CI. It lets you build and test against the same engine used in Azure SQL Database without needing an Azure subscription or credit card.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Centralized user authentication + JWT validation for Azure Application Gateway
item.description:
Azure Application Gateway now offers public preview for centralized user authentication using OpenID Connect, so sign-in can happen before traffic reaches the backend. The preview also includes an updated JWT validation experience.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Decision actions in Azure Logic Apps Automation
item.description:
Decision actions are in public preview for Azure Logic Apps Automation. They let developers automate business decisions with AI without deploying or managing models.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: DocumentDB enabled by Azure Arc
item.description:
Azure Arc public preview now supports DocumentDB deployment on supported Arc-enabled Kubernetes clusters across on-premises, edge, and multicloud environments. It is intended for running MongoDB-compatible document workloads closer to applications.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: DocumentDB on Azure Local
item.description:
Azure Local now has a public preview of DocumentDB, enabling MongoDB-compatible document workloads to run on customer-managed infrastructure. This is intended for scenarios where applications and data need to stay close together for latency or data-location requirements.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Durable Task SDK for Go
item.description:
The Durable Task SDK for Go is now in public preview. It lets developers write orchestrations, activities, and durable entities in Go, with Durable Task Scheduler handling execution history and work dispatch.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Embedding generation in Azure Cosmos DB
item.description:
Azure Cosmos DB now offers public preview of built-in embedding generation. The feature converts content into vector embeddings using Azure Data-developed models to support semantic search and retrieval.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Encryption at rest with customer-managed keys in Azure HorizonDB
item.description:
Azure HorizonDB now supports customer-managed keys (CMK) for encryption at rest in public preview. The service previously used only service-managed keys (SMK) by default.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Enhanced developer experience in Azure Logic Apps Automation
item.description:
Azure Logic Apps Automation is in public preview with updated developer experiences for building, managing, and scaling business process automation. The preview includes a refreshed workflow designer and reusable templates, along with faster environment and application setup.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Fine-grained role-based access control for databases and collections in Azure DocumentDB
item.description:
Azure DocumentDB public preview adds fine-grained RBAC for databases and collections. It expands beyond cluster-level permissions to let you manage access at the database and collection level.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Full-text search in Azure DocumentDB
item.description:
Azure DocumentDB now supports full-text search in public preview. The preview includes BM25 indexing, relevance-based sorting, relevance scores, fuzzy search, and proximity search.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Geo-redundancy on Azure App Service
item.description:
Azure App Service geo-redundancy is now in public preview. It lets customers build more resilient web apps across Azure regions without having to separately create and manage an App Service deployment in each region.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Hosted Skill and Agent Bindings for Azure Functions
item.description:
Hosted Skill and Agent bindings for Azure Functions are in public preview. The bindings aim to reduce application plumbing and lifecycle code needed when adding agents, so developers can focus on business logic.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: IP filtering in Azure Managed Redis
item.description:
Azure Managed Redis now supports firewall rules for data access in public preview. You can restrict cache connections by approved source IP addresses or Azure service tags.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Managed AI Models in Logic Apps Automation
item.description:
Managed AI Models are in public preview for Azure Logic Apps Automation. They let developers add AI capabilities to workflows and agents without provisioning, deploying, or managing model infrastructure.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Managed MCP Server in Azure Cosmos DB
item.description:
